builds.hypothesis: R threshold is source level-breakpoint base+0.8 bonusAD+1.5 lethality(Stat29). AD/lethality directly raise HP threshold; passive converts Edge health to AD. Bloodthirster adds80AD; Hubris has exactly10 kills. Profane/Youmuu/Edge/Axiom Arc supply lethality; EdgeHP becomes AD through passive. Item crit/armor penetration never multiply threshold. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.
